disposition_reason: Tables R1 to R6 print mean Pb, Cu, Zn (and Cd in roots) in dry and edible radish leaves and roots for three irrigation waters and three cultivars in a plastic-house experiment.

study.design: Plastic-house irrigation experiment, split-plot randomized complete block, 3 water types x 3 cultivars, 4 replicates
study.origin: Dohuk Research Center plastic house, Dohuk, Iraq (peat moss trays)

period.as_reported: sown before December fertilizer applications (18 and 31 December, 6-20 January); year not stated

study.method: Perchloric acid digestion of 0.5 g dried tissue at 240 C; AAS (GBC 932 AA)

material.label_as_printed: Radish leaves (Raphanus sativus L. var. sativus)

findings.group: irrigated with bottled drinking water, all cultivars
findings.notes: Plastic-house pot (peat moss tray) experiment, Dohuk Research Center; 4 replicates per treatment. AAS (GBC 932 AA). No LOD, CRM or recovery reported. Letters after values are Duncan groupings, omitted from value. Dry-matter basis (oven-dried 55 C). Lead at tens to over 100 µg/g, including plants watered with bottled drinking water, is far above typical radish levels; root Zn below 1 µg/g is unusually low against leaf Zn; treat magnitudes with caution.
